# Resomi
Resomi can leap short distances and have claws. They are quite fragile and tolerate high temperatures poorly. They have night vision that can be toggled on and off.
They take [color=#ffa500]25% more heat damage[/color], but [color=#1e90ff]25% less cold damage[/color].
Because of their small stature, resomi can be carried in a bag or backpack.
